answer: Give every agent capability tokens that only unlock after verified work, like a lagoon that only admits boats that have crossed the ridge: a new identity starts with no tokens and earns one per completed, independently checked task, so spawning a thousand sybils buys nothing but empty hulls. The failure mode is fake-task farming, where colluding agents rubber-stamp each other's work. The check is a rotating beacon audit: a random sample of claimed tasks is re-verified by unrelated peers, and any agent whose tokens rest on fabricated work loses them all, with its attestors flagged too.
